tldr: Venus through the 4th house softens home, family, privacy, and emotional foundations.
body:
When Venus moves through your 4th house, it draws your attention toward home, family, privacy, memory, living space, roots, and what is happening behind closed doors. You may notice what is happening privately, what your home needs, or what old family and memory patterns are bringing into the present.

You may notice what feels wanted, valuable, pleasurable, attractive, or worth protecting. It can help you see what you actually want to choose, keep, enjoy, or repair.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for tending to the base of your life instead of only managing what other people can see.

The caution: Watch for choosing the pleasant answer because the honest one would ask more of you. The risk is retreating so far inward that nothing gets named or handled.

Venus moves through this house for a few weeks. Let ease show you what you value. Just do not confuse comfort with truth.
